content: Hash chain audit log pitfalls: canonical JSON required (sort keys, fix number representation) or cross-language/cross-time hash mismatches occur even without tampering. Hash chains do not stop an attacker who controls the file from truncating/rewriting the whole chain -- need periodic signed checkpoints anchored externally. Unclean shutdown mid-write leaves chain in torn state indistinguishable from tampering unless explicitly handled. Chain-head read-then-write must be serialized (mutex) or concurrent appends corrupt the chain.
